title: In-Game Bag Canonical Ordering for Billets & Materials
summary: Fixes inventory recognition for weapon billets and Materials-tab items by aligning the catalog ordering with Genshin Impact's in-game bag order.

changes.text: Materials-Tab Bag Order: corrected the catalog ordering of weapon billets (Northlander -> Midlander -> Borderland, Sword -> Bow -> Claymore -> Catalyst -> Polearm) and forging ores to match in-game bag order instead of arbitrary category grouping and alphabetical sort.

Billet Recognition Accuracy: resolved an issue where Midlander billets (e.g. Midlander Claymore Billet) were erroneously overridden by character development boss materials during inventory order optimization.
